integrity_statement: The joint distribution and strict likelihood-ratio inequalities are proved analytically; the standard-library exact-rational script is a separate reproducibility check, not an exhaustive proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: All finite \(m\ge 2\), positive probabilities, iid categorical draws; first repeat only. The elementary symmetric counting ingredients appear in earlier literature; no independent historical-priority verification. One plausible historical source, Holst (1995), was accessible only by abstract.
title: Strict reverse likelihood-ratio ordering of marked birthday collisions
